title: fix: kanban title fallback chain and board visual improvements
body:
All kanban cards display "Untitled" when data objects use field names like `subject`, `label`, or `display_name` instead of `name`/`title`. The title resolver hardcoded `'name'` as default and only fell back to `item.title`.

### Title resolution

Replaced single-field lookup with a fallback chain:

```ts
const TITLE_FALLBACK_FIELDS = ['name', 'title', 'subject', 'label', 'display_name'];

// Explicit cardTitle from schema still takes priority, then objectDef metadata,
// then walks the fallback chain for first non-empty value
let resolvedTitle = titleField ? item[titleField] : undefined;
if (!resolvedTitle) {
  for (const field of TITLE_FALLBACK_FIELDS) {
    if (item[field]) { resolvedTitle = item[field]; break; }
  }
}
```

### Visual enhancements (KanbanImpl.tsx)

- **Card accent** — `border-l-4 border-l-primary/40` left border
- **Column header** — Count uses `Badge variant="secondary"` instead of plain text; header bg `bg-muted/30`
- **Empty state** — "No cards" placeholder when column has zero cards
- **Board container** — `bg-muted/10 rounded-lg` background

All changes are Tailwind-only, backward compatible, no DnD breakage. 10 new unit tests for the fallback chain; all 108 kanban tests pass.

> 🐛 Bug: All cards show "Untitled"
> 
> Root cause in ObjectKanban.tsx (line 126-133):
> 
> objectstack-ai / objectui / packages / plugin-kanban / src / ObjectKanban.tsx
>     const finalTitleField = titleField || 'name';
>     
>     return rawData.map(item => ({
>       ...item,
>       id: item.id || item._id,
>       title: item[finalTitleField] || item.title || 'Untitled',
> The title resolution defaults to the 'name' field, but todo_task objects likely use 'subject' or another field as their title. When item['name'] is empty/undefined and item.title doesn't exist in the raw data either, every card falls through to 'Untitled'.
> 
> Fix: Expand the fallback chain to try common field names (name → title → subject → label → display_name) and use the first non-empty value found.
> 
> 🎨 Enhancement: Visual improvements
> 
> The current board (as shown in your screenshot) is functionally working but visually bare:
> 
> Cards are plain white boxes with just "Untitled" text
> No color accents or visual hierarchy
> No empty state indicators in columns
> Columns lack visual distinction
> Improvements:
> 
> Card styling — Add subtle left-border accent, better padding, hover effects, and show card metadata (description, badges, assignee)
> Column headers — Add color accents, improve count badge visibility
> Empty columns — Show a placeholder when a column has zero cards
> Board container — Add subtle background for visual separation
